_comment: Reference shape for the Doubao desktop (豆包电脑端) custom MCP connector. The desktop UI fills these fields in a form (连接器·技能·伙伴 → 添加 → 新建自定义连接器); this file is only a copy/paste reference, not auto-loaded.
name: Agent Universe

_unauthenticated_local._comment: If the daemon was started WITHOUT MCP_BEARER_TOKEN (loopback only), delete the headers object entirely. Read-only tools work without a token; write/money tools are fail-closed and require a token.
_unauthenticated_local.name: Agent Universe (local, read-only)

_notes.default_port: 4002 is the gsn-daemon default MCP port. Use the actual --api-port if you changed it (the examples in this repo use 4012/4014).
_notes.token_env: The Bearer value must match the daemon's MCP_BEARER_TOKEN. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32 (macOS/Linux) or the install script.
_notes.protocol: Streamable HTTP (stateless), MCP protocol 2024-11-05. No SSE/stdio bridge is required on the Doubao side.
